run_experiment: run a SMC flow experiment with a given config and return AlgoResultsTuple
prepare_outer_loop: prepare the outer training loop for SMC, VI, SNF, AFT, or CRAFT algorithms
get_optimizer: get an Adam optimizer with optional piecewise constant learning rate schedule
is_flow_algorithm: check if an algorithm name is a flow-based algorithm like aft, vi, craft, or snf
is_annealing_algorithm: check if an algorithm name uses annealing like aft, craft, snf, or smc
